en.title: Kim Kardashian gets €1 in damages for being victim of Paris armed robbery
en.summary: A Paris court has awarded Kim Kardashian the €1 in compensation she requested following her 2016 armed robbery in the city, after eight individuals were previously convicted for their involvement in the incident.

stories.title: Scientists create mice with part-human brains

en.title: Scientists create mice with part-human brains
en.summary: Researchers have developed mice with half-human brains by transplanting lab-grown human brain cells into rodents engineered without a cortex or hippocampus. The goal is to better understand and develop treatments for neurological disorders including schizophrenia, epilepsy, and cerebral palsy.

en.title: The secret of Mozart's genius unlocked – has a teenager succeeded where generations of musicologists have failed?
en.summary: A US student analysed music by four canonical composers to identify distinguishing patterns. The research suggests Mozart's compositions are notably less predictable than those of other major composers.
